name: con-runrecord
notes: The run-record parser accepts a genuine recorded record and rejects one with an unknown closed-enum value. A real run is recorded, then its stored record parses cleanly (expectError:false). The single observation's verdict is then edited to a value outside the canonical verdict enum (pass|fail|error|skip|xfail|xpass|not_run); re-parsing MUST be a hard error. instrument.capabilities (F1, §3.4) is also exercised: capability *names* are open (an unknown/future name still parses), but values remain a closed enum (an unknown value is a hard error, scoped to the capabilities field itself so it does not interfere with the verdict-enum assertion below).
